conventions.rect: Unity RectTransform values as authored (anchors 0..1, y up, pivot 0..1, sizeDelta/anchoredPosition in canvas units).
conventions.layout: Resolved rects: size=[w,h]; box=[xMin,yMin,w,h] axis-aligned in the canvas ROOT local space (y up, origin = root pivot); pivot=[x,y] of the node pivot in that space. Layout groups are not re-run (Unity serialises their last result).
conventions.css: Screen canvases only: [left, top, width, height] in canvas units from the canvas top-left (y down) for each aspect in canvasSizes. Multiply by canvasSizes[k].scaleFactor to get device pixels.
conventions.world: World-space canvases: world.matrix maps canvas-root local units (x right, y up, origin = root pivot) to Unity world space. Unity is left-handed (+z forward); a right-handed three.js scene usually negates z: (x, y, -z), quaternion (-x, -y, z, w).
conventions.colors: hex is sRGB #rrggbb[aa]; rgba floats 0..1 as authored (project colour space affects nothing for UI).
conventions.sprites: Image.sprite is a key into sprites{}. file = texture under web/public, written at exportSize (exportScale x source; Unity itself renders it at unityImport.size). rect/border/pivot are in SOURCE-texture pixels (rect y from bottom, rectTopLeft y from top); rectExported/borderExported are the same in the exported file's pixels (use these for CSS border-image-slice / background-position). Border order: left, bottom, right, top. Sliced images: a border of b source px is drawn b * scaler.referencePixelsPerUnit / (sprite.ppu * image.pixelsPerUnitMultiplier) canvas units wide (Unity Image.multipliedPixelsPerUnit); if the rect is smaller than both borders Unity shrinks them proportionally.
conventions.themeDefault: Runtime overrides ThemeManager applies for the default pack (Default / SOLANA) — approximated from ThemeManager.cs rules; apply on top of the authored values.
conventions.activeInHierarchy: authored state at scene load; TableView.Initialize hides every seat until bound, BettingPanel.Hide() runs at start.
